# Western Governors University

> > WGU is an accredited online university offering flexible, competency-based bachelor's and master's degrees designed for working professionals seeking career advancement.

Western Governors University (WGU) specializes in accelerated, competency-based online education across business, healthcare, and technology fields. The university serves working professionals with flexible scheduling, affordable tuition, and degree programs designed for career development and advancement.

## Key Topics

- Competency-based learning
- Online degrees
- Flexible scheduling
- Bachelor of Science
- Master of Business Administration
- Working professionals
- Career advancement
- School of Business
- Program Mentor

- Affordable tuition
- Business management
- Healthcare administration
- Career development

## Core Programs & Degrees

- [Online Degrees and Programs](https://www.wgu.edu/online-degree-programs.html): Main page showcasing WGU's bachelor's and master's degree programs.
- [Online Business Degrees](https://www.wgu.edu/online-business-degrees.html): Overview of WGU School of Business accredited online degrees.
- [Online Business Master's Degree Programs](https://www.wgu.edu/online-business-degrees/masters-programs.html): Overview of WGU's online MBA and accelerated master's degree programs.

## Business Bachelor's Programs

- [Business Management Bachelor's Degree](https://www.wgu.edu/online-business-degrees/business-management-bachelors-program.html): B.S. Business Management program: flexible, competency-based bachelor's degree.
- [Accounting Bachelor's Degree](https://www.wgu.edu/online-business-degrees/accounting-bachelors-program.html): B.S. Accounting: accelerated bachelor's program with CPA certification prep.
- [Finance Bachelor's Degree](https://www.wgu.edu/online-business-degrees/finance-bachelors-program.html): B.S. Finance: bachelor's degree covering financial strategies and fintech.
- [Human Resources Bachelor's Degree](https://www.wgu.edu/online-business-degrees/human-resources-bachelors-program.html): B.S. Human Resources Management: flexible online bachelor's program.
- [Marketing Bachelor's Degree](https://www.wgu.edu/online-business-degrees/marketing-bachelors-program.html): B.S. Marketing: affordable, accelerated bachelor's program for professionals.
- [Supply Chain and Operations Management Bachelor's Degree](https://www.wgu.edu/online-business-degrees/supply-chain-operations-management-bachelors-program.html): B.S. Supply Chain and Operations Management with data analytics skills.
- [Communications Bachelor's Degree](https://www.wgu.edu/online-business-degrees/communications-bachelors-program.html): B.S. Communications: flexible online bachelor's for PR and media careers.
- [User Experience Design Bachelor's Degree](https://www.wgu.edu/online-business-degrees/user-experience-design-bachelors-program.html): B.S. UX Design: bachelor's degree in digital design and user interactivity.
- [Information Technology Management Bachelor's Degree](https://www.wgu.edu/online-business-degrees/it-information-technology-management-bachelors-program.html): B.S. IT Management: accelerated bachelor's for technology professionals.

## Healthcare & Management Master's Programs

- [MBA - Master of Business Administration](https://www.wgu.edu/online-business-degrees/mba-masters-business-administration-program.html): MBA program: flexible, accredited master's degree in business administration.
- [MBA in IT Management](https://www.wgu.edu/online-business-degrees/mba-masters-business-administration-it-management-program.html): MBA IT Management: master's degree for technology leadership professionals.
- [MBA in Healthcare Administration](https://www.wgu.edu/online-business-degrees/mba-masters-business-administration-healthcare-administration-program.html): MBA Healthcare Administration: master's program for healthcare leaders.

## Healthcare Programs

- [Healthcare Administration Bachelor's Degree](https://www.wgu.edu/online-business-degrees/healthcare-administration-bachelors-program.html): B.S. Healthcare Administration: accredited online bachelor's for professionals.
- [Health Information Management Bachelor's Degree](https://www.wgu.edu/online-nursing-health-degrees/health-information-management-bachelors-program.html): B.S. Health Information Management: accredited online degree for healthcare.
